title: Seasons and weather
examples: What is the weather like today?
What should I wear when it is rainy?

explain.say: There are four seasons in a year. They are spring, summer, autumn and winter.

draw.text: Four seasons: spring, summer, autumn, winter

explain.say: Look at the Earth going around the sun. Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
In spring, new flowers start to grow. Baby lambs are born. The weather can be wet.
Summer is the warmest season. The days are long and often sunny.
In autumn, the leaves change colour. Then many leaves fall to the ground.

draw.text: Autumn: leaves change colour and fall

explain.say: Winter is the coldest season. Sometimes it snows. You wear a warm coat outside.
Weather is what it is like outside today. It can be sunny, rainy, windy or snowy.

faq.q: What is the difference between seasons and weather?
faq.a: Seasons are big changes that happen over many months. Weather is what it is like outside right now.
asks: Are seasons the same as weather?
What is the difference between the two?

faq.q: Does it always rain in spring?
faq.a: No, spring can have different weather. It can be sunny, rainy, or a little bit of everything.

faq.q: What is the best season for swimming?
faq.a: Summer is usually the warmest season. It is great for playing near the water.
asks: When is it warm enough to swim?
Which season is best for the beach?

faq.q: Do I need a coat in autumn?
faq.a: Yes, autumn can get cool. A light jacket or coat is a good idea to wear.
asks: Should I wear a coat in fall?
Is it cold enough for a jacket in autumn?

faq.q: What is the weather word for cloudy?
faq.a: Cloudy means the sky is covered with clouds. It may rain, or it may stay dry.
asks: Is cloudy the same as overcast?

facts: The four seasons are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
In autumn, many trees lose their leaves.
Summer weather is usually warm and sunny.
Winter is the coldest season. It can bring frost and snow.

quiz.say: Look at the falling leaves. Tap the season.
quiz.why: In autumn, leaves change colour and fall from the trees.

wrong.0: Winter is the coldest season, and many trees are already bare.
wrong.2: In summer, the leaves on the trees are green.

quiz.say: Look at the hot sun and the beach. Tap the season.
quiz.why: Summer is the warmest season. The days are long and sunny.

wrong.0: Spring is when new flowers start to grow.
wrong.1: Winter is the coldest season of the year.

quiz.say: Look at the snow. Tap the season.
quiz.why: Snow comes when it is very cold. Winter is the coldest season.

wrong.1: Summer is the warmest season, so snow melts.
wrong.2: In autumn, the leaves fall and the air gets cool.
